definitions.explanation: The process of absorbing sound waves to reduce echo and reverberation. Used in acoustics, architecture, and interior design.

examples.english: To apply sound-absorbing material to the walls.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{吸音|きゅうおん}⟦{性能|せいのう}→性能：04340_seinou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: This room has high sound absorption performance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議室|かいぎしつ}→会議室：01265_kaigishitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{天井|てんじょう}→天井：05008_tenjou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{吸音|きゅうおん}⟦パネル→パネル：08840_paneru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{付|つ}けて→取り付ける：06797_toritsukeru⟧⟦{反響|はんきょう}→反響：09126_hankyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}えた→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧。
examples.english: Sound-absorbing panels were installed on the meeting room ceiling to reduce echo.

notes: Composed of {吸|きゅう} (absorb, inhale) + {音|おん} (sound). Distinct from ⟦{遮音|しゃおん}→遮音：19182_shaon⟧ (sound insulation, which blocks sound transmission) and ⟦{防音|ぼうおん}→防音：14565_bouon⟧ (soundproofing, the general term). {吸音|きゅうおん} specifically reduces echo and reverberation within a space. Common collocations: {吸音|きゅうおん}{材|ざい} (sound-absorbing material), {吸音|きゅうおん}⟦パネル→パネル：08840_paneru⟧ (acoustic panel), {吸音|きゅうおん}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ (sound absorption coefficient), {吸音|きゅうおん}⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧ (sound absorption effect). Materials like felt, foam, and perforated boards are common {吸音|きゅうおん}{材|ざい}.
